candidate.answerReason: The straight segment joining the same endpoints is shorter than the winding route, which is the principle stated in D.

methods.label: Shortest path between endpoints
methods.explanation: After the winding road is straightened, the route between the starting point and the endpoint becomes a line segment. Since “the line segment between two points is the shortest path,” the travel distance is shortened.
methods.levelReason: Directly applies the Grade 7 shortest-segment fact.
